title: report speed: Busy as a true union (FR-3) cannot match the RCA numbers AC-1 requires
context: Everything for report speed is built and committed except the AC-1 acceptance test, which pins the fixture numbers. FR-3 says Busy is the union of all intervals and FR-9 gives each 10-second bucket of busy time to the first active agent. Built exactly that way, the sanitized fixture gives: #625 busy 64m (development 31m, ceremony 29m, orchestrator 4m); #627 busy 74m (development 23m, ceremony 44m, orchestrator 8m, owner wait 4.1h); #702 busy 129m (development 74m, ceremony 52m, orchestrator 3m). AC-1 requires #625 and #627 within 5% of the RCA tables: 3.1h / 84m / 83m / 22m and 3.5h / 65m / 114m / 30m / 4.1h. The cause is the RCA script (crit.py): it adds a 10-second bucket for every 10-second step from each interval's own start second, so every tool call shorter than 10 s counts as 10 s and overlapping intervals that start on different seconds count twice. Applying that counting to the very same intervals reproduces the RCA exactly (#625 188/84/83/22 min, #627 209/65/114/30 min, #702 355/201/136/18 min). The #627 development agent ran only 32 minutes inside its window, so 65 minutes of development cannot come out of a true union. Owner wait already matches (4.09h vs 4.1h) because AskUserQuestion waits are not cut by the 1-hour tool cap. The report gives identical JSON on the real transcripts and on the fixture.
